capabilities: Render vault notes as a 3D force-directed graph or 2D physics network
Build graph hierarchies from inline tags like [topic::], [sub::], and [vocab::]
Filter the graph by vault folder and extracted topic tags
Navigate to the source file and line by clicking leaf nodes
Re-index the vault on demand with a manual refresh
extras: Manual installation only (files copied from GitHub releases into the plugins folder); the listing notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
motivation: Originally built for advanced language learning and vocabulary organization before being generalized to any topic.
problem: Obsidian's built-in graph view is link-based and offers no way to build curated, hierarchical mind maps from custom inline tags, with 3D depth effects or folder/topic scoping.
summary: Spatial graph plugin that renders notes as interactive 3D force-directed or 2D physics mind maps built from inline [topic::] and [vocab::] tags.
